description: T1 - Lime tree to be re pollard back to previous points.T2- horse chestnut to be cutback by 1-1.5 meters away from exisiting building.
decision_conditions: All tree works will be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998: 2010 Tree work. Recommendations. In order to carry out the tree works to BS 3998:2010 there will be only the removal of secondary and tertiary branches, no primary branches. All finalpruning cuts on the branches will not exceed a third of the diameter of the main stem of the tree when measured at 1.5 meters above ground level. Reason: To ensure that the works are carried out in accordance with good arboricultural practice.

This decision notice for Tree Works is only valid for 2 years from the date of this decision or until the work is completed, whichever is the sooner. Reason: In order to ensure that the work is carried out whilst still appropriate and in accordance with the time period within the legislation and regulations.

No valid justification has been provided with the Application to demonstrate the necessity of the proposed repollarding works to T1 Lime. The pruning would involve removing the majority of the existing upper canopy, topping the tree at approximately 11 metres, resulting in significant harm to both the trees' amenity value and health and condition.The reasons given for the works relate to issues related to the footpath within the rooting area of the tree and the application form states there is 'alleged property damage'. Nevertheless, no supporting information has been provided to quantify this. The footpath comprises concrete flag stones, laid directly onto the existing  turf with no obvious sub-base.  No Arboricultural link can be formed  between  pollarding the tree and preventing further displacement or issues. Lesser work to reduce the tree and enable the removal of dead wood within the crown, has been granted as routine arboricultural works .
